description: Blind, domain-agnostic HOT-boundary cases. Every case embeds the client offer/outcome and the item evidence needed for judgment. Labels and pair metadata live in hot_boundary_expected.json.
judge_instructions: Judge each case independently with playbooks/LEAD_QUALIFICATION_RULE.md v12.
Use only client_offer and item evidence; do not infer buying intent from industry, occupation, launch status, or possible benefit.
Return one canonical judgment object per id. Evidence fields must cite the item-specific facts that support the selected state.

item.text: I'm validating which dispatch problems matter most before our beta. If you manage a field crew, would you fill out this 60-second survey? Everyone who responds gets early access. I'm collecting the answers myself this week.
